title: I built a focused Steam game explorer with AI filters: one game at a time, trailer and screenshots up front
author: Herr_Lonewolf
selftext:
Browsing Steam lists means hovering over every card to see what a game actually looks like. So I made a focused explorer: one game at a time, with the trailer already playing next to 3 large screenshots, plus the tags, reviews and description. Save it or skip it, and skipped games don’t show up again.

**AI filters**, based on each game’s AI disclosure on Steam:

* **No AI**: hide every game that discloses AI use
* **No AI or minor AI**: allow small uses like translation or placeholder voices
* **AI only** / **Heavy AI only**: if you want to see them, or avoid them knowingly

Also: tag and keyword search, plus lists for new releases, upcoming games, and upcoming games with a playable demo (Next Fest-style).

Free, no account needed, and your saved list stays in your browser.

👉 

It’s a hobby project on free hosting, so the first load can take up to a minute after it’s been idle. Not affiliated with Valve or Steam. Feedback welcome!
